posts.label: Quote 1
posts.quote: Be patient toward all that is unsolved in your heart.
posts.fb_caption:
Some questions aren't meant to be answered right now — they're meant to be held. ✨

Tonight's prompt: what's one thing in your life right now that you're trying to solve or understand before you're ready? Write about what it would feel like to simply sit with it — without forcing the answer yet.

Save this one for the next time you find yourself pushing for clarity before it's there. 💜

#Zenie #zenieapp #journaling #RainerMariaRilke #selfreflection #innerpeace #journalprompt
posts.hypothesis: Short Rilke line using the patience-with-questions angle for the first time in this account; testing whether sitting-with-uncertainty framing earns more FB comments than the resolution-focused quotes we ran in August and early September — if it does, we have a new quote register to lean on.
